justification: Inspected `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/Implementation.java` (lines 579-790) and call sites in `TypeWriter.java`, `ClassVisitorFactory.java`, and `AccessControllerPlugin.java`. `FrameGeneration` is a small 3-constant enum (`GENERATE`, `EXPAND`, `DISABLED`) with methods only for stack-map frame emission (`isActive`, `same`, `same1`, `append`, `chop`, `full`, and `generate`) plus two private conversion helpers. The usages I found are all limited to ASM frame writing, so the class is cohesive and does not show clear insufficient modularization.
